pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Desktop is Anthropic's Electron desktop application for Claude.ai, offering the same Chat, Cowork, and Claude Code experience as the macOS and Windows apps. This package installs Anthropic's upstream amd64/arm64 prebuilt .deb payload under /opt/claude-desktop; it does not build the Electron app from source. Cowork's sandboxed VM support additionally needs QEMU/KVM (see optfeature). Linux support is upstream beta.
